in_marathi.name: Satyapal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Truthful, just, or protector of nature
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyapal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Satyapal is a name of Indian origin which is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Satya', meaning truth, and 'Pal', meaning protector or friend. This name is believed to represent someone who is truthful, just, and a protector of nature. It is a strong and meaningful name for a boy in Hindu culture.
